elder:
Last night, a runner reached us with an empty water flask. The watch at the fort has wounded men, and the road is no longer safe. My son is among them.

Every household gave a handful of grain. Take the bundle beside the store and mount Badal. Follow the ridge to the saffron flag. Bring our people home when you can.
lookout:
Below the ridge, smoke rises from the road camp. A patrol now holds the crossing that the runner used last night.

Badal cannot pass quietly. Dismount at the flag and observe the route. The grain must reach the fort before another road closes.
observe:
The guard turns at the bend. Beyond that bend, the northern ridge leads to the gate. There is room to pass if you wait.

Press C to crouch. Move when the guard faces away, and keep your distance. You carry food for the wounded, not a reason to fight.
guard:
Keshav sent you? His son reached us before dawn. He is alive. The bandages you carry will do more for him than another sword.

Suryaji waits in the courtyard. Go through the arch. I will watch the road behind you.
oath:
We counted enough grain for one more night. Now the watch can stay, and the wounded can recover. Tell Keshav his son asked for him.

Remember what brought you here: a village shared what little it had. Swarajya must mean that we protect those people in return. That is your first oath.

Rest and explore the fort. The western water route will be our next concern.
smith: That blade belonged to a farmer before it belonged to a fighter. Keep it sheathed until you need it. A safe delivery matters more than a duel.
trader: I put my own grain in that bundle. Leave the sack at the fort. Bring me news of the people there.
villager: Keshav waited by the road all night. If you find his son, tell him his father kept the lamp burning.
